Kanawha Capital Management Lowered Its Apple (AAPL) Stake; Orbimed Advisors Has Lifted Its Insmed (INSM) Holding
May 29, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Kanawha Capital Management Llc decreased Apple Inc (AAPL) stake by 2.01% reported in 2018Q1 SEC filing. Kanawha Capital Management Llc sold 1,878 shares as Apple Inc (AAPL)’s stock rose 5.37%. The Kanawha Capital Management Llc holds 91,470 shares with $15.35M value, down from 93,348 last quarter. Apple Inc now has $926.90B valuation. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $188.58. About 15.45 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since May 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Orbimed Advisors Llc increased Insmed Inc (INSM) stake by 95.61% reported in 2018Q1 SEC filing. Orbimed Advisors Llc acquired 1.43M shares as Insmed Inc (INSM)’s stock rose 4.66%. The stock increased 0.77% or $0.21 during the last trading session, reaching $27.61. About 319,673 shares traded. Insmed Incorporated (NASDAQ:INSM) has risen 61.09% since May 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 48.52% the S&P500.
